{{Quote|Flagship ''Dauntless'' here. Patching you through to the command deck.|A communications officer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Dauntless''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] that was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] it served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] during the [[Battle of Rishi]]. Initially pitted against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] fleet, the course of the battle turned when [[Theron Shan]] and his allies revealed that ''Dauntless'' and other ships on both fleets were filled with saboteurs from the [[Order of Revan]]. Shan formed a temporary truce with [[Darth Marr]] and took ''Dauntless'' to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with the rest of her fleet, a move to which [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] later objected.
